about: The river agent's fragment (S3 Run 2): the boats' kit options and moves, their crews, the far bank moved 5.5 m north west of the hall on stilts, the water and banks as built (river_plan.json).

S3.veh.boat_under_way_15595.why: S4b's raft at real size reaches 3-6 m past u 15500 over this boat's painted water (S4b's sterns at X 92-93 between D 13 and 29.7): moved east (astern, over open water) until its bow lies 0.3 m clear of S4b's mat-cargo boat's stern in the gap between S4b's arched-awning and mat-cargo boats, and 3 m south so that the towed boat passes north of it as painted (its run cut to 1 m: people_boats.json). The rest of the reach is packed: the towed boat north of it, the unloading boat south-east, its sweep blade 0.3 m off the near shore.

S3.veh.boat_towed_mast_16228.why: S4b's raft sterns (X 92-93, D 23-29.7) cover its painted place at real size: moved east 13.4 m (outward, over open water) so its stern lies 0.3 m clear of S4b's mat-cargo and long-cabin boats, and 2.7 m south to pass south of the long passenger boat moored along the moved far bank and north of the boat under way, as painted (north-east of the boat under way, its bow toward the far row). Its 4 m run east (people_boats.json) stays clear of the lowered-mast and mat-cabin boats.

S3.veh.boat_passenger_long_16398.why: moored along the far bank: moved with it 5.5 m north (river_plan.json far_bank_move; about dX -3.3 along the receding direction), then 1.7 m east of that and 0.6 m south so that its bow clears the stern of S4b's long-cabin boat (0.3 m) and it lies 0.25 m off the far shore; it lies north of S4b's raft at the seam, at the far bank's west tip, as painted.

S3.veh.boat_awning_17442.why: moored along the far bank: moved with it (5.5 m north) and on east along it, end to end behind the long passenger boat (the far row at real size is longer than its painted 28 m), 0.25 m off the far shore, its stern 0.6 m short of the mooring post.

S3.veh.boat_lowered_mast_17708.why: the far row at real size is longer than the far bank west of the hall on stilts (P 17 m, then this and two small boats of 6.3 m each, from the far bank's west tip to the step at u 18300): this boat is moved outward over open water, rafted 0.3 m south-east of the awning boat's stern (the lead's rule: shorten to 0.6, then move outward), keeping the far row's order west to east.

S3.veh.boat_mat_cabin_18005.why: the last of the far row: moved 1.3 m east and 0.8 m south so that it lies moored at the hall on stilts' west end (painted: its east end touches the hall at u 18322), in front of the far bank's step at u 18300 (the far bank west of it moved 5.5 m north), clear of the lowered-mast boat and the towed boat's run.

S3.veh.boat_unloading_17705.why: at real size its stern ran onto the land at the bridge's south-west foot and its hull over the mapped near shore (the land in front of the mat shed juts to D 13.4): moved 3.7 m north (outward, over open water) so its hull lies 0.35 m off the near shore, and 4.3 m west so that its stern clears the south ramp's far skirt and the south abutment; it stays moored along the shore in front of the shed, bow west toward the 新酒 pole.

S3.veh.boat_mast_lowering_19518.why: at real size the hull overlapped the arch, the skiff, S2's moored cargo boat and the seam: its stem post (3.1 m above the water) can't pass under the arch's near face (soffit less the 0.46 m facing timber: 3.23 m at the crown), so the bow lies outside the face; shortened to 0.6 and moved 3.6 m south and 1.3 m west along the face so that the hull lies wholly on S3's side of u 20500, 0.4 m south of S2.veh.boat_mat_cargo_21055 (taken at 0.6 of the grain type on its mapped place) and 0.4 m off the south shore, its bow 0.4 m outside the arch's near face. Cost to loyalty: the painted bow points at the arch's middle (u 19518, near the crown); built, it points at its south quarter (station 6.7 of 25.5).

S3.veh.boat_skiff_19255.why: at its mapped place its west end ran into the south abutment and under the arch's ribs where they stand 0.6 m over the water (the review's clearance from its built geometry: -0.31 m): moved 3.1 m north and 0.7 m west, along the abutment's river face, its west end under the arch at station 6.7 (the ribs about 1.3 m over the water, about 0.3 m over its stern), its east end just outside the near face, clear of the big boat's bow and of the cabin boat. Still 'under the arch's south half, parallel to the south bank'; it no longer lies against the south bank (1.5 m off it).

S3.veh.boat_moored_south_bank_19745.why: at real size its west end ran onto the south bank's corner at X 144.6-146.2 and its south side 0.5 m onto the bank: moved 1.1 m north (off the bank, 0.4 m) and 0.75 m east along it. Its east end reaches about 6 m past u 20500 at the south bank, as painted (its east end at u 20637), over S2's water where S2 maps no boat.

S3.prop.mooring_post_17702.why: the post at the far bank's water edge between the awning boat and the lowered-mast boat: the far bank moved 5.5 m north and the awning boat lies moored along it with the lowered-mast boat rafted outside its stern (boats), so the post stands at the moved water's edge 0.75 m past the awning boat's stern, its mooring line's end (boats.S3.veh.boat_awning_17442.kit.moor)

S3.fig.far_bank_seated_18318.why: in the far-bank shed S3.bld.far_bank_shed_18280 (u 18318-18322, just past the far bank's step at u 18300): moves with the shed, 5.5 m north along the receding direction (river_plan.json far_bank_move)

S3.prop.far_chair_18322.why: in the far-bank shed S3.bld.far_bank_shed_18280 (u 18318-18322, just past the far bank's step at u 18300): moves with the shed, 5.5 m north along the receding direction (river_plan.json far_bank_move)

S3.grd.far_bank_seam_15500.why: the far bank's piece at the S4b seam, running off the silk's top edge: moved with S4b's far bank (S4b.grd.far_bank_15330: dX -2.26, dD +5.5 along the receding direction), so the two far banks meet at the seam (the lead's call: our north bank meets S4b's at u 15500)

S3.tree.willow_crown_top_15520.why: on S3.grd.far_bank_seam_15500 (the far bank at the S4b seam): moved with it; and 0.6 m further north: its mapped foot (the top of its whips at the silk's edge) stood 0.3 m inside the water where the far shore meets S4b's moved one at the seam (its head and trunk are beyond the silk's top edge)

S3.veh.boat_under_way_15595.why: 摇橹向前 (types #6): a cargo boat riding high under a big arched mat roof, worked by its great sweep over the low stern. kind grain (as painted: mat-covered hold, horn beam at the bow). lw 12.0 (0.6 of the type): painted 370-400 px long against its 62-90 px crew, about 5 figure lengths (10-12 m), and at 20 m it would run into S4b's raft sterns. beam 2.8 (Song inland proportion for a 12 m hull; painted beam_n-beam_s 2.6 m). free 0.6 (choice): the layout's stern top gives 0.52 (the low stern the sweep crew stand on, deck H -0.13); with the kit's sheer the after deck lands at 0.66 above the water, the bow at 1.6 (painted raised bow deck H 1.12 = 1.82). hold awning: the arched mat roof (painted over most of the hull; the kit's awnings cover 0.30-0.78). cabin false: no crew house aft (the sweep crew stand where the kit's house would be; boats_page_lessons). sweep port: the blade trails astern a little to the south (u 16070-16135, v 555-570, just below the hull's axis). Waits on the kit factory: B9 raised bow deck (the three bowmen at H 1.12), B1 awnings over the whole length.

S3.veh.boat_towed_mast_16228.why: 逆水行舟's twin at S3 (types #7): a heavily laden cargo boat seen from its stern, its A-frame mast up with stays, towed by the five trackers. kind grain, hold laden (the mat-covered cargo heaped high over the stern half; the kit's mound with its rope net); free from the layout's bow top (0.65). lw 12.0 (0.6 of the type): seen end-on its mapped 2.5 m is foreshortened; 12 m keeps it in the river's packed west reach. beam 3.1. mast up (the kit's 9 m A-frame, the painted ladder look), tow_to tracker_16333: the tow line from the masthead made fast to the rear tracker, as the map says. Waits on the kit factory: B7 mast form (the painted mast is a single ladder-like pole or an A-frame seen edge-on), and the bow beam with the poler (the kit's grain horns stand in).

S3.veh.boat_passenger_long_16398.why: The very long passenger boat moored at the far bank (types #8): kind passenger, a continuous cabin of lattice windows from the bow deckhouse to the stern cabin (cabin 0.08-0.92 of the hull, three roof segments for the painted raised roof section and the upper deckhouse aft). lw 11.4 (0.6 of the type; painted 945 px, 11.9 m mapped): the far row (this boat and three more end to end) has about 28 m of far bank at the frame's scale. beam 2.9 (Song proportion). bow_canopy false (its deckhouse reaches the bow), stern_house false (the painted upper deckhouse is no higher than the cabin), cargo none (nothing on its roof). free from the layout (0.52: painted low, its doorway figure at H -0.36).

S3.veh.boat_awning_17442.why: The boat with a fore awning and a high mat cabin moored at the far bank (types #9): kind small, not passenger (the catalogue's preset): painted 265 px against the long passenger boat's 945 px (0.28 of it), so at the passenger boat's 11.4 m it would be 3.2 m; the small type at 5.0 m (0.63 of its 8 m) is the closest real size, and a passenger hull (at least 11.4 m) would not fit the far row. The small type's arched mat awning stands for its high mat cabin. moor: to the mooring post at the water's edge past its stern. Waits on the kit factory: B1 awnings anywhere (its fore awning and its cabin), B2 pointed small bow.

S3.veh.boat_lowered_mast_17708.why: The long low boat with its mast lowered on a crutch (types #9-10, conf low): kind small (painted 290 px, 0.31 of the passenger boat: a grain hull of at least 12 m, the catalogue's preset, would not fit the far row). mast down (the kit's A-frame laid aft over the roof, its foot at the bow, west: the painted crutch at the west end holding a spar that runs east past the stern), mast_h 6.0 (choice: the painted spar is 370 px, longer than the 290 px hull). Waits on the kit factory: B7 the mast crutch, B11 fenders (the heavy log-like wales), B1 its low roof.

S3.veh.boat_mat_cabin_18005.why: The boat with a dark arched mat cabin and two passengers (types #10, conf low): kind small (the catalogue's preset, small_awning): painted 315 px; lw 5.0 (0.63 of the type), beam 2.2. Its stern hood waits on the kit factory (B6 small-hull stern).

S3.veh.boat_unloading_17705.why: The cargo boat unloading at the south bank (types #11): kind grain, lw 12.0 (0.6 of the type; painted about 600 px with its stern under the awnings against 110-135 px porters, 10-12 m), beam 3.0. free 1.2: riding high, its foredeck where the six porters stand at H 0.21 (0.91 above the water; the layout's bow top gives 0.49). hold hatch (no awning over the foredeck, where the porters work: the kit's awnings would cover 0.30-0.78, over them), cabin: the arched mat hood and flat mat awnings over its stern half as a low mat-roofed house aft (0.03-0.42, wall_h 1.3: painted about 1.5 m over the deck; the kit's 1.7 m house roof stood 3.8 m over the water). cargo: jars at the bow, sacks and a basket amidships (painted: jars and bundles on the foredeck, dark sacks heaped amidships). It touches the south bank: the page opens its rail there (walk aboard from the bank). Waits on the kit factory: B10 grapnel under the bow, B1 flat mat awnings on poles over the stern.

S3.veh.boat_mast_lowering_19518.why: 大船抢险 (types #12): built with the passenger preset as the lead set (kind by hand: kind_of reads grain), mast lowering. lw 11.4 (0.6 of the type: the area agent's call (a): its painted 11.0 m, kept whole on S3's side of u 20500, its bow outside the arch's near face; at 19 m its stern would run 8-12 m into S2 over S2.veh.boat_mat_cargo_21055). beam 3.3 (choice, Song proportion; painted beam_n-beam_s 4.0 m). cabin: the painted planked after cabin under the high poop and the mat-roofed deckhouse amidships as one cabin of boards from 0.03 to 0.55 of the hull (three roof segments), wall_h 1.4 so that its roof (3.35 m above the water) lands near the painted poop (2.5-3 m, river_e; the four poop hands at H 2.29 drop onto it). stern_house false: the kit's raised house stands 4.7 m over the water, far over the painted poop. bow_canopy false (an open forward deck). mast lowering, mast_at 0.5: the A-frame's foot amidships (hidden), its head lowered aft over the poop (painted head at (20295, 175)). cargo: the coiled rope at the bow and the striated bundle (a mat roll) on the forward deck. free from the layout's bow top (0.86; painted 0.78 amidships, 0.86 at the bow). Clearance: wholly outside the arch's plan (incl. the facing timber) at rest and through its 0 m run, so nothing of it passes under the soffit (river report). Waits on the kit factory: B3 windlass at the squared bow (the kit's passenger bow platform and curled stem post stand in).

S3.veh.boat_cabin_under_arch_19225.why: The cabin boat under the arch (not in the factory's inventory): kind small, lw 10.0 (the lead's small range 8-12 m), beam 2.6, free from the layout (0.73: the painted cabin floor 0.71 above the water). Why not the catalogue's passenger: a passenger hull at 0.6 (17.2 m over all) is longer than the arch is wide along its heading (12.96 m at D 20), so a high end (the curled stem post at 3.0 m, the stern gallery rail at 3.3 m) would stand under a face where the soffit less its facing timber is 1.9-2.1 m; and the long hull would overlap S2's moored cargo boat and the big boat. The small hull lies wholly under the arch with its mat awning crown 1.8 m above the water, under a soffit of 2.4-3.6 m along its 3 m drift. Cost to loyalty: painted as a long boat (≥ 725 px) with a railed open cabin under a planked roof; built as a 10 m awning boat. Waits on the kit factory: B4 open cabin (railed sides, planked roof) on a low hull.

S3.veh.boat_skiff_19255.why: The narrow empty skiff under the arch's south foot (conf low): kind small, open (awning false: thwarts and floor boards), lw 4.8 (0.6 of the type; painted 340 px, mapped 4.8 m), beam 1.6 (painted slim), free from the layout (0.35: its gunwale painted 0.29 above the water). Nothing on it (no crew, oar, pole or line painted).

S3.veh.boat_moored_south_bank_19745.why: The long boat moored along the south bank past the arch, its hull hidden by the shops' roofs (types #13): kind small (not the catalogue's grain): its painted mat roof stands about 1.2 m above the water (the waving man's feet at H 0.48), where a grain hull's awnings rise 3-3.8 m; the small hull's arched mat awning (crown 1.7 m) is the closest, so the two men on its roof stand on it. lw 12.0 (painted 895 px against its 155 px waver: about 12 m; the lead's small range 8-12 m), beam 3.0. Waits on the kit factory: B1 awnings anywhere (its mat roof at the west part, the hatch amidships, the long low planked roof aft).
